title: **Title:** POST AUTHENTICITY ALERT! New Rule: No AI Comments Allowed!
script:
**Title:** "POST AUTHENTICITY ALERT! New Rule: No AI Comments Allowed!"

**Script:**

(Upbeat background music starts playing. The host, a lively and energetic creator, appears on screen with a friendly smile)

Host: "Hey everyone, we've got a new rule to share with you all! Starting now, AI-generated posts and comments are strictly prohibited on our platform!"

(Visuals of a robot trying to post a comment appear on screen, with a red X marked through it)

Host: "Here's why: 1) Lack of personal touch, 2) Misinformation, 3) Over-reliance on algorithms, and 4) Taking away from human connection!"

(Closing shot of the host winking at the camera)

Host: "Let's keep it real, folks!"
